requirements.lead_text: Project. With your counselor's guidance, select three different programming languages and development environments. For each subrequirement below, do the following: Write or modify a program using the indicated programming language and development environment. The program must take input and produce output based on computations and decisions made on the input. Debug and demonstrate the program to your counselor. Explain how each program processes inputs, makes decisions based on those inputs, and provides outputs based on computations and decision making.

requirements.lead_text: Careers. Do ONE of the following:
requirements.req_text: Careers. Do ONE of the following: (a) Explore careers related to this merit badge. Research one career to learn about the training and education needed, costs, job prospects, salary, job duties, and career advancement. Your research methods may include—with your parent or guardian's permission—an internet or library search, an interview with a professional in the field, or a visit to a location where people in this career work. Discuss with your counselor both your findings and what about this profession might make it an interesting career. (b) Explore how you could use knowledge and skills from this merit badge to pursue a hobby or healthy lifestyle. Research any training needed, expenses, and organizations that promote or support it. Discuss with your counselor what short-term and long-term goals you might have if you pursued this.

pamphlet_excerpts: Programming Sub-Req 6a: Explore careers related to this merit badge. Research one career to learn about the training and education needed, costs, job prospects, salary, job duties.
Programming Sub-Req 6b: Explore how you could use knowledge and skills from this merit badge to pursue a hobby or healthy lifestyle. Research any training needed, expenses.
Core Standard 1 (Req 6): Do ONE of the following: (a) Explore careers related to this merit badge.
Core Standard 2 (Req 6): Research one career to learn about the training and education needed, costs, job prospects, salary, job duties, and career advancement.
step_by_step_procedure: Prepare & Inspect (Req 6): Review the official Programming requirement standard and verify all required tools, reference tables, and safety gear.
Analyze Core Principles: Identify the primary concepts, definitions, and cause-and-effect relationships governing Programming Careers, Training & Hobby Pathways.
Execute & Document: Perform the careers task methodically with your patrol buddy and log specific observations in your Programming Workbook.
Verify With Counselor: Present your completed work, demonstrate proficiency, and answer Socratic check-for-understanding questions for Blue Card sign-off.
